clips.title: The story
paras: Along Darkshore’s misty coast, crabs lose legs that most travelers have no use for. Their tough limbs can help keep a gnome’s communication device working.

Darkshore’s crabs leave sturdy limbs along the shore, from pygmy tide crawlers to reef crawlers. Night elf sentinels pay them little mind, but the gnome engineer Wizbang Cranktoggle has found a use for them. Working from Auberdine, Wizbang designed his prototype long-distance communication devices, called buzzboxes, to run on improvised local components. Crawler legs’ segmented joints and durable chitin provide the friction and leverage needed to repair Buzzbox 827, along the shoreline just south of town.
